ex.en: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.

ex.en: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.

ex.en: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.

ex.en: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.

ex.en: Then We produced after them a generation of others.

ex.en: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.
ex.bn: তোমরা যদি তোমাদের মতই একজন মানুষের আনুগত্য কর, তাহলে তোমরা অবশ্যই ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত হবে।

ex.en: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?
ex.bn: সে কি তোমাদের সঙ্গে এই ওয়া‘দা করে যে, যখন তোমরা মরে যাবে আর মাটি ও হাড্ডিতে পরিণত হবে তখন তোমাদেরকে আবার জীবিত করা হবে।

ex.en: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.
ex.bn: দূরে ওটা, বহু দূরে যার ওয়া‘দা তোমাদেরকে দেয়া হচ্ছে।

ex.en: It [i.e., life] is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.

ex.en: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.

ex.en: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.

ex.en: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.

ex.en: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.

ex.en: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allāh] for help.
ex.bn: অবশেষে আমি যখন তাদের (অর্থাৎ কাফিরদের) মধ্যে বিত্ত সম্পদশালীদেরকে শাস্তি দ্বারা পাকড়াও করব, তখন তারা চিৎকার জুড়ে দেবে।

ex.en: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels.
ex.bn: আমার আয়াত তোমাদের কাছে পড়ে শোনানো হত, কিন্তু তোমরা গোড়ালির ভরে পিছনে ঘুরে দাঁড়াতে।
